headline: Revenue and profit both climb sharply in the first half
summary_short: H1 FY2026 revenue was ¥13.69bn, up 61.2% y/y, with net income of ¥2.92bn, up 73.7% y/y; the shard's discrete Q2 EPS of ¥0.85 rose 31.7% q/q from ¥0.6455.
summary_long: H1 FY2026 revenue reached ¥13.69bn, up 61.2% y/y from ¥8.49bn. Net income rose 73.7% y/y to ¥2.92bn, and H1 EPS of ¥1.5021 was up 72.8% y/y from ¥0.8693. On a discrete-quarter basis, the shard's Q2 EPS of ¥0.85 rose 31.7% q/q from ¥0.6455 — consistent with the H1 total (Q1 + Q2 ≈ ¥1.50, within rounding of the reported ¥1.5021). No margin, guidance, or balance-sheet figures were available from the wire-service recap; drivers and guidance are not assessed (kpi-only pass, no primary filing or press release read).
